entities.summary: James David Maslow is an American actor, singer, dancer and model. He played the role of James Diamond on Nickelodeon's Big Time Rush, had roles in The Frozen Ground and Seeds of Yesterday, and is a member of the boyband Big Time Rush. James Maslow was a composers & musicians from New York City (b. 1990-07-16, New York City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
